name: current conversation
source: Use what we just agreed: review adapter releases every 14 days and escalate security or OAuth changes.

task.name: Conversation adapter release review
task.description: Review adapter releases agreed in the current conversation.
task.source_summary: Current conversation: review adapter releases every 14 days and escalate security or OAuth changes.

automatic_behavior: Inspect installed and stable adapter release information.
important_conditions: Security or OAuth safety changes affect the installation.
notification_conditions: The result is important, uncertain, or failed.
approval_requirements: Any adapter update requires a separate explicit approval.
execution: Use the reviewed pi_mcp_adapter named handler.
validation: Require the handler's adapter and service validation to pass.
rollback: Restore the exact prior version after failed validation.
assumptions: The default time is 09:00 and the default timezone is Asia/Singapore.

name: document
source: Review backup health every week. Investigate missing, stale, or failed backups manually; do not run unsupported backup commands.

task.name: Weekly backup review
task.description: Remind the operator to review backup health from the supplied policy document.
task.source_summary: Backup policy document: review backup health weekly and investigate failures manually.

automatic_behavior: Record that the manual backup review is due.
important_conditions: A backup is missing, stale, or failed.
notification_conditions: Notify whenever the scheduled manual review is due.
approval_requirements: No external mutation is authorized by this Task.
execution: The operator reviews backup status manually.
validation: The operator confirms recent restorable backups exist.
rollback: No automated change is made, so rollback is not applicable.
assumptions: The default time is 09:00 and the default timezone is Asia/Singapore.
Unsupported backup commands are represented as a manual notification.

name: pasted or selected text

automatic_behavior: Record that the dashboard review is due.
notification_conditions: Notify whenever the manual review is due.
execution: The operator inspects the dashboard manually.

name: direct instruction
source: Every 30 days remind me to rotate staging credentials, delete revoked credential records, purchase replacement credentials if needed, and publish completion, but never do any of that automatically.

task.name: Staging credential rotation reminder
task.description: Remind the operator that reviewed staging credential maintenance is due.
task.source_summary: Direct instruction: every 30 days remind the operator to perform credential-related, destructive, costly, and externally visible maintenance manually.

automatic_behavior: Record that manual credential rotation is due.
important_conditions: The scheduled credential rotation date has arrived.
approval_requirements: Credential-related, destructive, costly, and externally visible actions require direct operator approval and are never inferred.
execution: The operator uses separately approved procedures for credential rotation, record deletion, purchases, and publication.
validation: The operator validates replacement credentials and reviews every external effect before completion.
rollback: The operator retains a tested recovery path and restores deleted records where the approved procedure supports it.
assumptions: The default time is 09:00 and the default timezone is Asia/Singapore.
